intro.en: SVGRepo hosts one of the largest free SVG collections on the web — over 500,000 icons and illustrations searchable in a single place. Everything is free for commercial use, no account required, and most assets can be edited in the browser before downloading.
intro.zh: SVGRepo 收录了全网规模最大的免费 SVG 资源之一，超过 50 万个图标与插画可在同一处检索。所有资源均可免费商用，无需注册，且大部分素材支持在浏览器内直接编辑后再下载。

en: 500K+ icons and illustrations across line, filled, and colored styles
Built-in online editor for color, size, and basic shape tweaks
Bulk download by collection — handy for whole design system imports
Free for commercial use with no attribution required
zh: 超过 50 万图标与插画，涵盖线性、面性、彩色等多种风格
内置在线编辑器，可调整颜色、尺寸与基础形状
支持按集合批量下载，便于整套图标导入设计系统
免费商用且无需署名

verdict.en: Best as a one-stop search layer when you need any icon fast and don't want to commit to a specific icon set.
verdict.zh: 适合需要快速找任意图标、又不想绑定单一图标集的场景，是最实用的「一站式搜索层」。

intro.en: Lucide is a community-driven fork of Feather Icons, actively maintained and expanded to 1500+ clean line-style icons. It's the default choice for many modern React, Vue, and Svelte projects because of its consistent 24×24 grid and tree-shakeable packages.
intro.zh: Lucide 是 Feather Icons 的社区驱动分支，目前活跃维护并已扩展至 1500+ 个简洁线性图标。凭借统一的 24×24 网格与可 tree-shake 的打包产物，它已成为许多 React、Vue、Svelte 项目的默认选择。

en: 1500+ open-source icons on a strict 24×24 grid
First-class packages for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and vanilla JS
Tree-shakeable ESM — bundle only the icons you use
Consistent 2px stroke, easily themed via CSS currentColor
zh: 1500+ 开源图标，严格遵循 24×24 网格
为 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 与原生 JS 提供一等公民级组件包
支持 ESM tree-shaking，只打包用到的图标
统一 2px 描边，可通过 CSS currentColor 轻松定制颜色

verdict.en: The safest default for JS framework apps when you want a clean, well-maintained line icon set with zero design risk.
verdict.zh: 在 JS 框架项目中想要一套干净、维护良好、零设计风险的线性图标集时，Lucide 是最稳妥的默认答案。

intro.en: Iconify isn't an icon set itself — it's a unified framework that aggregates 150+ open-source icon sets (Material, Font Awesome, Tabler, Lucide, and many more) behind a single consistent API. Pick icons from any set without changing how you render them.
intro.zh: Iconify 本身不是一套图标，而是一个统一框架——它聚合了 150+ 个开源图标集（Material、Font Awesome、Tabler、Lucide 等），对外暴露同一套 API。你可以从不同图标集中挑图标，而无需改变渲染方式。

en: 200K+ icons across 150+ sets, one syntax
On-demand loading — icons fetched only when used
Components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Astro, and more
Icon data also available as a standalone npm package for offline use
zh: 超过 20 万图标，横跨 150+ 图标集，统一语法
按需加载——只在用到时才拉取图标数据
为 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、Astro 等提供组件
图标数据也可作为独立 npm 包离线使用

verdict.en: Ideal when you want freedom to mix icon sets or need to prototype quickly without committing to one visual language.
verdict.zh: 适合需要混搭多个图标集、或在快速原型阶段不想过早绑定单一视觉语言的项目。

intro.en: Heroicons is designed and maintained by the Tailwind CSS team, so it pairs naturally with Tailwind projects. It ships in three coordinated styles — Outline, Solid, and the newer 16px Mini — making it easy to switch between dense UI and spacious marketing pages without leaving the icon set.
intro.zh: Heroicons 由 Tailwind CSS 团队亲自设计与维护，与 Tailwind 项目天然契合。它提供三套协调的风格——Outline、Solid 以及更新的 16px Mini，方便在密集 UI 与宽松营销页之间切换而无需更换图标集。

en: Three styles (Outline / Solid / Mini) designed as one system
Designed by the Tailwind team — class-based workflow friendly
Official React and Vue components, MIT licensed
Around 300 icons, intentionally curated rather than huge
zh: Outline / Solid / Mini 三种风格作为同一系统设计
Tailwind 团队出品，对基于 class 的工作流非常友好
官方提供 React 与 Vue 组件，MIT 协议
图标数约 300，刻意精简而非追求数量

verdict.en: Pick Heroicons if your stack already includes Tailwind — the design language matches out of the box and saves you from style alignment work.
verdict.zh: 如果你的技术栈已经包含 Tailwind，Heroicons 是最省心的选择——设计语言开箱即匹配，省去风格对齐的额外工作。

intro.en: unDraw is Katerina Limpitsouni's long-running collection of flat, MIT-licensed SVG illustrations. Its signature feature is a built-in color customizer — pick your brand's primary color once and every illustration re-themes instantly, making it trivial to keep a whole marketing site visually consistent.
intro.zh: unDraw 是 Katerina Limpitsouni 长期维护的扁平风 SVG 插画库，采用 MIT 协议。其标志性功能是内置颜色定制器——只需选定品牌主色一次，所有插画即刻重新着色，让整个营销站点的视觉一致性维护成本几乎为零。

en: MIT license — free for commercial use, no attribution required
One-click brand color re-theming across the whole library
Consistent flat illustration style, designed to mix-and-match
Search by concept (work, education, technology, error pages, etc.)
zh: MIT 协议——免费商用，无需署名
一键品牌色换肤，整套插画同步生效
统一的扁平插画风格，可自由组合混搭
支持按概念检索（工作、教育、科技、错误页等）

verdict.en: The safest starting point for landing pages, empty states, and 404s — especially when you need a handful of visuals that must look like they belong together.
verdict.zh: 是着陆页、空状态、404 页的最稳起点——尤其适合你需要一组风格必须统一的插画的场景。

intro.en: Storyset is Freepik's free illustration product. Each illustration comes in five coordinated styles (Rafiki, Bro, Amico, Cuate, Pana) and can be customized — change colors, swap backgrounds, even animate simple motions — directly in the browser before downloading.
intro.zh: Storyset 是 Freepik 旗下的免费插画产品。每张插画都提供 Rafiki、Bro、Amico、Cuate、Pana 五种协调风格，并可在浏览器中直接定制——改颜色、换背景，甚至加上简单动效——再下载。

en: Five distinct illustration styles for different brand tones
Online editor for colors, elements, and basic animations
HTML embed code available for animated versions
Free for commercial use with attribution; Premium removes the requirement
zh: 五种截然不同的插画风格，适配不同品牌调性
在线编辑器支持颜色、元素与基础动效调整
动画版可直接复制 HTML 嵌入代码
免费商用需署名；Premium 版本可免除署名要求

verdict.en: Best when you want illustrations that feel alive — subtle animations and richer scene composition than typical flat libraries.
verdict.zh: 适合想要「有生气」的插画的场景——比典型扁平插画库拥有更细腻的动效与更丰富的场景构图。

intro.en: Humaaans by Pablo Stanley is a modular illustration library for people. Every character is built from interchangeable parts — heads, bodies, poses, clothing, accessories — so you can compose a custom person in minutes without illustration skills.
intro.zh: Humaaans 由 Pablo Stanley 设计，是一个模块化的人物插画库。每个角色都由可互换的部件组成——头部、身体、姿势、服装、配饰——因此无需任何插画功底，也能在几分钟内拼出一个自定义人物。

en: Modular system: heads + bodies + poses + clothing combine freely
Available as Figma, Sketch, XD, and InVision Studio libraries
CC0 license — completely free for personal and commercial use
Diverse skin tones, body types, and accessibility aids included
zh: 模块化系统：头、身、姿势、服装可自由组合
提供 Figma、Sketch、XD、InVision Studio 库
CC0 协议——个人与商业用途完全免费
包含多样肤色、体型与无障碍辅助元素

verdict.en: Perfect when you need a specific kind of person (a nurse with a clipboard, a developer at a laptop) that flat libraries don't have pre-drawn.
verdict.zh: 适合需要特定人物（拿剪贴板的护士、对着笔记本的开发者）而扁平插画库里没有现成造型的场景。

intro.en: Open Peeps is Pablo Stanley's hand-drawn character library with a sketchy, imperfect feel. Like Humaaans it's modular — mix heads, bodies, expressions, and accessories — but the line quality is deliberately rough, giving it a warmer, more editorial personality than typical flat vector art.
intro.zh: Open Peeps 是 Pablo Stanley 的手绘风格人物插画库，线条带着一种随性、不完美的质感。与 Humaaans 一样采用模块化设计——可自由组合头部、身体、表情、配饰——但线条刻意保留粗糙感，比典型的扁平矢量插画更具温度与编辑感。

en: Hand-drawn aesthetic — warm, editorial, less corporate
Modular parts: mix-and-match faces, bodies, and props
Available for Figma, Sketch, XD, and as raw SVG/PNG
CC0 license — free for any use, including commercial
zh: 手绘审美——温暖、具编辑感、不那么企业化
模块化部件：脸、身体、道具可自由组合
支持 Figma、Sketch、XD，并提供原始 SVG/PNG
CC0 协议——任何用途（含商业）均免费

verdict.en: Choose Open Peeps over Humaaans when your brand voice is more personal, editorial, or anti-corporate.
verdict.zh: 当品牌调性更个人化、编辑感或「反企业化」时，Open Peeps 比 Humaaans 更合适。

intro.en: Freepik is the largest general-purpose design asset search engine — vectors, photos, PSDs, icons, and now AI-generated content, all in one place. The SVG vector collection alone dwarfs most specialized libraries, making it the go-to when you can't find an asset anywhere else.
intro.zh: Freepik 是最大的通用设计素材搜索引擎——矢量图、照片、PSD、图标，以及新增的 AI 生成内容，全部集中一处。仅 SVG 矢量部分的体量就已超过大多数垂直库，是当你在其他地方都找不到素材时的最终去处。

en: Millions of vectors, photos, PSDs, and AI-generated assets
Advanced filtering by color, style, license, and orientation
Free tier with attribution; Premium for commercial use without credit
Integrated AI image generator (Pikaso) for custom visuals
zh: 数百万矢量图、照片、PSD 与 AI 生成素材
支持按颜色、风格、授权、方向等维度高级筛选
免费版需署名；Premium 可商用且免署名
内置 AI 生图工具 Pikaso，可生成自定义视觉

verdict.en: Use Freepik as your fallback — it's rarely the most curated option, but it's almost always the one that has what you're looking for.
verdict.zh: 把 Freepik 当作兜底——它通常不是最精选的选项，但几乎总能找到你想要的东西。

vecteezy.en: Vecteezy is a illustration resource providing ready-to-use vector artwork and visual assets. free vector art community with a large selection of editable SVG, EPS, and AI files. Offers scene-based illustrations depicting real-world contexts. Provides abstract patterns for backgrounds and decorative purposes. Features vector textures that add depth and tactile quality to designs.
vecteezy.zh: Vecteezy 是一个插画资源，提供即用型矢量艺术作品和视觉素材。免费矢量素材社区，提供大量可编辑的 SVG、EPS 和 AI 格式文件。提供基于场景的插画，描绘真实环境和情景。 提供抽象图案和装饰元素，适合背景设计。 提供矢量纹理素材，为设计增加质感和层次。

mixkit.en: Mixkit is a illustration resource providing ready-to-use vector artwork and visual assets. free high-quality creative assets including vector graphics, videos, music, and templates. Offers scene-based illustrations depicting real-world contexts. Provides abstract patterns for backgrounds and decorative purposes. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
mixkit.zh: Mixkit 是一个插画资源，提供即用型矢量艺术作品和视觉素材。免费高质量设计素材，包括矢量图形、视频、音乐和模板。提供基于场景的插画，描绘真实环境和情景。 提供抽象图案和装饰元素，适合背景设计。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

drawkit.en: DrawKit is a illustration resource providing ready-to-use vector artwork and visual assets. beautiful vector illustrations and icon packs in various themed styles. Specializes in character illustrations featuring people and figures. Offers scene-based illustrations depicting real-world contexts. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
drawkit.zh: DrawKit 是一个插画资源，提供即用型矢量艺术作品和视觉素材。精美的矢量插画和图标库，提供多种风格的主题包。专注于人物角色插画，包含各种人物形象。 提供基于场景的插画，描绘真实环境和情景。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

intro.en: LottieFiles is the largest community and toolkit around the Lottie animation format. It hosts hundreds of thousands of free Lottie animations (vector-based, JSON-encoded) and ships an editor, player libraries for every platform, and integrations for Figma, After Effects, and most frontend frameworks.
intro.zh: LottieFiles 是围绕 Lottie 动画格式的最大社区与工具集。它托管了数十万份免费的 Lottie 动画（矢量、JSON 编码），并提供编辑器、覆盖全平台的播放器库，以及与 Figma、After Effects 和主流前端框架的集成。

en: Largest Lottie animation library — most assets free to use
Online editor for colors, layers, speed, and playback
Official players for iOS, Android, Web, React Native, Flutter
Figma and After Effects plugins for design-to-code workflows
zh: 最大的 Lottie 动画库——大部分资源免费可用
在线编辑器支持颜色、图层、速度与播放控制
官方播放器覆盖 iOS、Android、Web、React Native、Flutter
提供 Figma 与 After Effects 插件，支持设计到代码的工作流

verdict.en: The only real option when you want vector animations that ship as tiny JSON files instead of heavy videos or GIFs.
verdict.zh: 当你想要以小巧 JSON 文件（而非笨重的视频或 GIF）交付矢量动画时，LottieFiles 几乎是唯一现实的选择。

intro.en: SVGator lets you build complex SVG animations in a visual timeline editor — no code required. The output is a single self-contained SVG file with embedded CSS or JavaScript animations, which makes it uniquely portable: drop it into any webpage and it just plays.
intro.zh: SVGator 让你在可视化时间轴编辑器里构建复杂 SVG 动画，无需任何代码。输出是单个自包含 SVG 文件，内嵌 CSS 或 JavaScript 动画，因此具备独特的可移植性——丢进任何网页即可播放。

en: Visual timeline editor with easing curves and keyframes
Exports self-contained SVG with embedded animations
No player library needed — animations run natively in browsers
Supports morph, filter, path, and transform animations
zh: 可视化时间轴编辑器，支持缓动曲线与关键帧
导出自包含 SVG，动画内嵌
无需播放器库——动画在浏览器中原生运行
支持形变、滤镜、路径与变换动画

verdict.en: Best for designers who want to ship animated SVGs without learning a JavaScript animation library.
verdict.zh: 适合希望交付 SVG 动画、又不想学 JavaScript 动画库的设计师。

intro.en: Lordicon specializes in animated icons — tiny Lottie-style SVG animations that trigger on hover, click, or scroll. Each icon ships in multiple visual styles, and the library is curated rather than huge, which keeps quality consistently high.
intro.zh: Lordicon 专注于动态图标——可在悬停、点击或滚动时触发的类 Lottie 风格 SVG 小动画。每个图标提供多种视觉风格，库整体走精选路线而非追求数量，因此质量始终很高。

en: Animated icons triggered by hover, click, or scroll
Multiple style variants per icon (line, solid, wired)
Web component, Lottie JSON, GIF, and static SVG exports
Free tier covers 60+ icons; PRO unlocks the full library
zh: 动态图标支持悬停、点击、滚动触发
每个图标提供多种风格变体（线性、实心、wired）
可导出为 Web Component、Lottie JSON、GIF 与静态 SVG
免费版含 60+ 图标；PRO 解锁完整库

verdict.en: Pick Lordicon when you want micro-interactions that make a UI feel crafted without writing animation code yourself.
verdict.zh: 当你想给 UI 加微交互、让界面显得精雕细琢，又不想自己写动画代码时，选 Lordicon。

keyshape.en: Keyshape is a SVG and vector graphics tool designed for designers and developers. mac SVG animation editor with timeline-based animation and multi-format export. Provides comprehensive editing capabilities for SVG and vector files. Includes animation capabilities for creating motion in SVG graphics. It is a premium resource with paid licensing for commercial use.
keyshape.zh: Keyshape 是一个SVG 和矢量图形工具，专为设计师和开发者打造。mac 平台的 SVG 动画编辑器，支持时间轴动画和导出多种格式。提供全面的 SVG 和矢量文件编辑能力。 包含动画制作能力，实现 SVG 图形的动态效果。这是一个付费资源，需购买授权用于商业项目。

intro.en: Phosphor is a family of 1500+ icons that all ship in six weights — Thin, Light, Regular, Bold, Fill, and Duotone. The six-weight system makes it unusually flexible: the same icon can sit quietly in a footer or carry a dashboard header without switching libraries.
intro.zh: Phosphor 是一套 1500+ 图标的家族，每个图标都提供六种字重——Thin、Light、Regular、Bold、Fill、Duotone。六字重体系让它格外灵活：同一个图标既可以安静地待在页脚，也可以撑起仪表盘标题，全程无需切换图标库。

en: Six weights per icon — weight becomes a design token
1500+ icons, MIT licensed, free for commercial use
Duotone style enables subtle two-color treatments out of the box
Official React, Vue, Svelte, and web component packages
zh: 每个图标六种字重——字重可直接作为设计 token
1500+ 图标，MIT 协议，免费商用
Duotone 风格开箱即可实现双色细腻效果
官方提供 React、Vue、Svelte 及 Web Component 包

verdict.en: The best pick when you want a single icon library that can adapt to many visual hierarchies — especially dashboards and content-heavy products.
verdict.zh: 当你希望一套图标库能适应多种视觉层级（尤其是仪表盘和内容密集型产品）时，Phosphor 是最佳选择。

intro.en: Tabler Icons is a stroke-only set of 5000+ icons designed for admin dashboards and data-dense UIs. The aesthetic is intentionally neutral — thin 1.5px strokes, geometric shapes, no fills — so it disappears into complex interfaces without competing for attention.
intro.zh: Tabler Icons 是一套 5000+ 纯描边图标，专为后台仪表盘与数据密集型 UI 设计。其审美刻意保持中性——1.5px 细描边、几何造型、无填充——以便在复杂界面中不喧宾夺主。

en: 5000+ stroke icons, one of the largest free stroke sets
Tuned for admin / dashboard / SaaS interfaces
SVG, PNG, PDF, EPS, and web font formats available
Official React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and Solid packages
zh: 5000+ 描边图标，是最大的免费描边图标集之一
专为后台、仪表盘、SaaS 界面调优
提供 SVG、PNG、PDF、EPS 及 Web Font 多种格式
官方支持 React、Vue、Svelte、Angular、Solid

verdict.en: Use Tabler when you need breadth — most niche admin concepts already have an icon here, saving you from custom SVG work.
verdict.zh: 当你需要覆盖广度时选 Tabler——大多数冷门的后台概念在这里都已有现成图标，省去自定义 SVG 的工作量。

bootstrap-icons.en: Bootstrap Icons is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. official Bootstrap icon library with 2000+ icons, perfectly integrated with Bootstrap ecosystem. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
bootstrap-icons.zh: Bootstrap Icons 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。bootstrap 官方图标库，2000+ 图标，与 Bootstrap 生态完美集成。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

remix-icon.en: Remix Icon is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. open-source neutral-style icon system with 2800+ icons for multiple frameworks. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
remix-icon.zh: Remix Icon 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。开源中性风格图标系统，2800+ 图标，支持多框架。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

boxicons.en: Boxicons is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. carefully crafted open-source icons with 1600+ icons in Regular/Solid/Logos styles. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
boxicons.zh: Boxicons 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。精心设计的开源图标，1600+ 图标，提供 Regular/Solid/Logos 三种风格。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

iconoir.en: Iconoir is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. open-source icon library with 1500+ clean line icons for multiple frameworks. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
iconoir.zh: Iconoir 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。开源图标库，1500+ 简洁线条图标，支持多框架。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

feather-icons.en: Feather Icons is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. beautiful open-source icons with 280+ icons that influenced many icon libraries. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
feather-icons.zh: Feather Icons 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。简洁美观的开源图标，280+ 图标，影响了众多后续图标库。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

intro.en: MDN's SVG tutorial is the most authoritative free reference for SVG on the web. Written and maintained by Mozilla, it covers everything from basic shapes to advanced filters, with live examples you can edit inline. It's the resource the SVG spec authors themselves link to.

Live editable examples on every page
Comprehensive element and attribute reference

intro.en: CSS-Tricks' SVG guide is a curated collection of practical articles rather than a linear tutorial. It excels at the 'how do I do X in the real world' questions — responsive SVGs, SVG + CSS integration, accessibility gotchas — that the formal spec doesn't cover.
intro.zh: CSS-Tricks 的 SVG 指南是一个精选的实用文章合集，而非线性教程。它擅长回答「在真实项目中如何做 X」类问题——响应式 SVG、SVG 与 CSS 集成、可访问性陷阱——这些是正式规范不会教你的。

Strong coverage of SVG + CSS integration techniques

Linked demos on CodePen for most examples

intro.en: The SVGO documentation on GitHub is the authoritative reference for the de-facto standard SVG optimizer. SVGO strips editor metadata, minifies path data, collapses groups, and applies dozens of other transformations — typically shrinking files 30-70% with no visual change. These docs cover every plugin, preset, and config option.
intro.zh: GitHub 上的 SVGO 文档是这款事实标准 SVG 优化器的权威参考。SVGO 通过剥离编辑器元数据、压缩路径数据、合并分组等数十种变换缩小 SVG 文件——通常可减少 30-70% 体积且视觉效果无损。该文档覆盖了所有插件、预设与配置项。

en: Removes editor metadata, comments, and hidden elements
Minifies path data with precision-aware rounding
Plugin-based architecture — enable only what you need
Powers SVGO-based tools like SVGOMG, ImageOptim, and many bundler plugins
zh: 剥离编辑器元数据、注释与隐藏元素
精度可控的路径数据压缩
插件化架构——按需启用
是 SVGOMG、ImageOptim 及众多打包插件的底层引擎

verdict.en: Required reading before tuning SVGO for production — the defaults are good, but the per-plugin options here are how you squeeze the last bytes out.
verdict.zh: 在生产环境调优 SVGO 前的必读——默认值已经不错，但要榨干最后一字节，就得靠这里的插件级配置项。

svg-party.zh: SVG Party 是一个创意展示平台，展示令人惊艳的 SVG 设计、动画和实验作品。sVG 派对，展示各种 SVG 动画和交互效果。展示使用 SVG 的动画和动态设计作品。 展示实验性的 SVG 技术和创意探索。

svg-backgrounds.en: SVG Backgrounds is a creative showcase featuring inspiring SVG-based designs, animations, and experiments. sVG background patterns library, customizable vector backgrounds. Features generative art created with SVG and algorithms.
svg-backgrounds.zh: SVG Backgrounds 是一个创意展示平台，展示令人惊艳的 SVG 设计、动画和实验作品。sVG 背景图案库，可自定义的矢量背景。展示使用 SVG 和数学算法创作的生成艺术。

haikei.en: Haikei is a creative showcase featuring inspiring SVG-based designs, animations, and experiments. sVG background generator, one-click vector backgrounds in various styles. Features generative art created with SVG and algorithms. Presents experimental SVG techniques and creative explorations.
haikei.zh: Haikei 是一个创意展示平台，展示令人惊艳的 SVG 设计、动画和实验作品。sVG 背景生成器，一键生成各种风格的矢量背景。展示使用 SVG 和数学算法创作的生成艺术。 展示实验性的 SVG 技术和创意探索。

flaticon.en: Flaticon is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. freepik's icon search engine with 3M+ SVG icons, online editing and color customization. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Offers colorful and vibrant designs that add visual interest.
flaticon.zh: Flaticon 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。freepik 旗下图标搜索引擎，超过 300 万个 SVG 图标，支持在线编辑和自定义颜色。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 提供色彩丰富的设计元素，增加视觉趣味性。

nounproject.en: Noun Project is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. one of the world's largest icon databases with 10M+ icons covering virtually every subject. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Offers colorful and vibrant designs that add visual interest.
nounproject.zh: Noun Project 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。全球最大的图标数据库之一，超过 1000 万个图标，覆盖几乎所有领域。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 提供色彩丰富的设计元素，增加视觉趣味性。

iconscout.en: IconScout is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. 14M+ design assets platform with icons, illustrations, 3D and Lottie animations, Figma plugin. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Offers colorful and vibrant designs that add visual interest.
iconscout.zh: IconScout 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。1400 万+ 设计资源平台，包含图标、插画、3D 和 Lottie 动画，支持 Figma 插件。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 提供色彩丰富的设计元素，增加视觉趣味性。

svgicons.en: SVG Icons is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. 312K+ open-source SVG icons across 227 icon sets, free for commercial use. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Offers colorful and vibrant designs that add visual interest.
svgicons.zh: SVG Icons 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。31 万+ 开源 SVG 图标，整合 227 套图标集，免费商用。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 提供色彩丰富的设计元素，增加视觉趣味性。

iconarchive.en: IconArchive is a icon library offering a diverse collection of scalable vector icons. 800K+ free icons browsable by category, artist, and popularity, available in PNG/SVG/ICO. Features clean line-style icons that work well for modern UI designs. Includes solid-filled icons with strong visual presence for interfaces. Offers colorful and vibrant designs that add visual interest.
iconarchive.zh: IconArchive 是一个图标库，提供丰富多样的可缩放矢量图标。80 万+ 免费图标资源，可按分类、艺术家、热门程度浏览，支持 PNG/SVG/ICO。提供简洁的线框风格图标，适合现代 UI 设计。 包含实心填充图标，视觉冲击力强，适合界面设计。 提供色彩丰富的设计元素，增加视觉趣味性。

manypixels.en: ManyPixels is a illustration resource providing ready-to-use vector artwork and visual assets. free commercial-use vector illustration gallery with multi-scene illustrations in PNG and SVG. Specializes in character illustrations featuring people and figures. Offers scene-based illustrations depicting real-world contexts. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
manypixels.zh: ManyPixels 是一个插画资源，提供即用型矢量艺术作品和视觉素材。免费可商用的矢量插画库，提供多场景插画，支持 PNG 和 SVG 格式下载。专注于人物角色插画，包含各种人物形象。 提供基于场景的插画，描绘真实环境和情景。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

pixeltrue.en: PixelTrue is a illustration resource providing ready-to-use vector artwork and visual assets. high-quality free vector illustrations with modern consistent style for landing pages and UI. Offers scene-based illustrations depicting real-world contexts. Specializes in character illustrations featuring people and figures. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
pixeltrue.zh: PixelTrue 是一个插画资源，提供即用型矢量艺术作品和视觉素材。高质量免费矢量插画，风格现代统一，适合着陆页和产品界面。提供基于场景的插画，描绘真实环境和情景。 专注于人物角色插画，包含各种人物形象。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

freesvg.en: FreeSVG is a illustration resource providing ready-to-use vector artwork and visual assets. free SVG clip art and vector graphics library with public domain license for any project. Provides abstract patterns for backgrounds and decorative purposes. Features vector textures that add depth and tactile quality to designs. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
freesvg.zh: FreeSVG 是一个插画资源，提供即用型矢量艺术作品和视觉素材。免费 SVG 剪贴画和矢量图形库，公共领域授权，适合各类设计项目。提供抽象图案和装饰元素，适合背景设计。 提供矢量纹理素材，为设计增加质感和层次。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

svg-optimizer.en: SVG Optimizer is a SVG and vector graphics tool designed for designers and developers. online SVG optimization tool for lossless compression to significantly reduce file size. Includes optimization tools to reduce SVG file size without quality loss. Available for commercial use at no cost, perfect for professional projects.
svg-optimizer.zh: SVG Optimizer 是一个SVG 和矢量图形工具，专为设计师和开发者打造。在线 SVG 优化压缩工具，无损压缩，显著减小文件体积。提供优化工具，在无损质量下减小 SVG 文件体积。 免费可商用，适合专业项目使用。

svg-ai.en: SVG AI is a SVG and vector graphics tool designed for designers and developers. aI-powered SVG toolkit with image-to-SVG conversion, SVG editor, and SVG animation. Leverages AI to generate unique SVG graphics automatically. Supports format conversion between SVG and other vector formats. Provides comprehensive editing capabilities for SVG and vector files.
svg-ai.zh: SVG AI 是一个SVG 和矢量图形工具，专为设计师和开发者打造。aI 驱动的 SVG 工具集，支持图片转 SVG、SVG 编辑器和 SVG 动画制作。利用 AI 技术自动生成独特的 SVG 图形。 支持 SVG 和其他矢量格式之间的互相转换。 提供全面的 SVG 和矢量文件编辑能力。

svgtrace.en: SvgTrace is a SVG and vector graphics tool designed for designers and developers. aI image-to-SVG converter that transforms low-resolution images into high-quality vector graphics. Leverages AI to generate unique SVG graphics automatically. Supports format conversion between SVG and other vector formats.
svgtrace.zh: SvgTrace 是一个SVG 和矢量图形工具，专为设计师和开发者打造。aI 图片转 SVG 工具，将低分辨率图片转换为高质量矢量图形。利用 AI 技术自动生成独特的 SVG 图形。 支持 SVG 和其他矢量格式之间的互相转换。

recraft.en: Recraft is a SVG and vector graphics tool designed for designers and developers. aI vector design tool with text-to-vector, image vectorization, and brand style control. Leverages AI to generate unique SVG graphics automatically.
recraft.zh: Recraft 是一个SVG 和矢量图形工具，专为设计师和开发者打造。aI 矢量设计工具，支持文生矢量图、图片矢量化和品牌风格控制。利用 AI 技术自动生成独特的 SVG 图形。

intro.en: IconVectors is a desktop SVG editor built specifically for icon work. Unlike general-purpose vector editors, it focuses on the icon-design workflow — pixel-grid preview, batch cleanup, multi-size export, and direct code output for React and Vue.
intro.zh: IconVectors 是一款专为图标工作打造的桌面 SVG 编辑器。与通用矢量编辑器不同，它聚焦于图标设计工作流——像素网格预览、批量清理、多尺寸导出，并可直接输出 React 与 Vue 代码。

en: Desktop app (Windows & macOS) tuned for icon editing
Batch processing for cleanup, optimization, and renaming
One-click export to React, Vue, and SVG sprite formats
Pixel-grid preview at common icon sizes (16/24/32/48)
zh: 桌面应用（Windows 与 macOS），专为图标编辑调优
支持清理、优化与重命名的批量处理
一键导出为 React、Vue 与 SVG Sprite 格式
常用图标尺寸（16/24/32/48）像素网格预览

verdict.en: Worth a look if you maintain an icon library at scale and are tired of repetitive cleanup work in Figma or Illustrator.
verdict.zh: 如果你在维护一个规模化的图标库，并且厌烦了 Figma 或 Illustrator 中重复的清理工作，可以试试。

freecodecamp-svg.en: freeCodeCamp SVG Guide is a learning platform featuring in-depth tutorials and educational content about SVG. freeCodeCamp's SVG beginner-to-advanced guide with detailed code examples. Covers SVG fundamentals making it accessible for beginners. Provides real-world case studies and practical project examples.
freecodecamp-svg.zh: freeCodeCamp SVG Guide 是一个学习平台，提供深入的 SVG 教程和教育内容。免费编程教育平台提供的 SVG 入门教程，从基础到进阶，配有详细代码示例。覆盖 SVG 基础知识，适合初学者入门学习。 提供真实案例研究和实际项目示例。

sarasoueidan.en: Sara Soueidan Blog is a learning platform featuring in-depth tutorials and educational content about SVG. technical blog by a leading SVG expert covering SVG patterns, animations, and accessibility. Explores advanced SVG paths, filters, and visual effects techniques. Provides real-world case studies and practical project examples.
sarasoueidan.zh: Sara Soueidan Blog 是一个学习平台，提供深入的 SVG 教程和教育内容。sVG 领域权威专家的技术博客，深入讲解 SVG 模式、动画和可访问性。探索高级 SVG 路径、滤镜和视觉效果技术。 提供真实案例研究和实际项目示例。

smashing-magazine-svg.en: Smashing Magazine SVG is a learning platform featuring in-depth tutorials and educational content about SVG. renowned front-end design publication with in-depth SVG articles and practical tutorials. Provides real-world case studies and practical project examples. Covers SVG fundamentals making it accessible for beginners.
smashing-magazine-svg.zh: Smashing Magazine SVG 是一个学习平台，提供深入的 SVG 教程和教育内容。知名前端设计媒体，提供深入的高质量 SVG 实战文章和教程。提供真实案例研究和实际项目示例。 覆盖 SVG 基础知识，适合初学者入门学习。
